newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan electronics jump on Wall Street gains.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan electronics jump on Wall Street gains.

text.p: Taiwan's blue chip electronics shares were strong in late trade on Thursday, reflecting the overnight strength of high-technology listings on Wall Street, brokers said.
With 60 minutes left, Mosel was up T$1.3 or 3.62 percent to T$37.2 and United Microelectronics 90 cents or 2.53 percent to T$36.5. Computer giant Acer Inc was up 90 cents or 2.18 percent to T$42.1.
Expected price hikes for integrated circuit chips should boost computer companies' performances, brokers said.
"The fourth quarter is the traditional hot sales season for electronic firms. The prospect looks good for these firms," said Eric Liu of National Securities.
The government's recent effort to curb speculative sentiment in the stock market also helped to boost buying in blue chip stocks, brokers said.
